_comment: Accepted SDK coverage gaps vs the API contract. Gaps listed here downgrade from error to warning in scripts/check-filter-shape-conformance.ts. Each entry is tracked backlog: remove it in the same PR that closes the gap in the SDK. `missing_filters` maps a resource to filter params the mapped method does not expose; `unimplemented_resources` lists contract resources with no SDK method at all. The assistance/* resources (financial-assistance awards) are not yet ported.
